entities.summary: Orrin Thomas Upshaw was an American tug of war athlete who competed in the 1904 Summer Olympics. In the 1904 Olympics, he won a silver medal as a member of Southwest Turnverein of Saint Louis No. 1 team. He was born in WaKeeney, Kansas and died in St. Louis, Missouri.
